metadata.title: Why You Can Solve a Quantum Oscillator Without Ever Solving It
metadata.thing: an evenly spaced energy ladder where a raise-arrow steps a dot up and a lower-arrow steps it down, hitting a floor it cannot pass
metadata.color_notes: The dot + raise arrow + ladder = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. The floor it cannot pass + the killed-state X + closing emphasis = red #C0392B. Energy axis, rungs, labels = ink #1a1a1a.

beats.narration_text: Finding every energy of a quantum oscillator looks like a brutal differential equation.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Finding every energy of a quantum oscillator looks like a brutal differential equation.

beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person overwhelmed in front of a wall of equations]

beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: But two simple moves — step up, step down — hand you the whole answer.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But two simple moves — step up, step down — hand you the whole answer.
beats.new_visual_element: the person relieved, holding an up arrow and a down arrow
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person holding a big up arrow and a big down arrow, relieved]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person smiling with an up arrow and a down arrow]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person draws in holding an up arrow and a down arrow, relieved and smiling; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Picture the oscillator's energy on a vertical axis, with a state sitting at some level.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Picture the oscillator's energy on a vertical axis, with a state sitting at some level.
beats.new_visual_element: an energy axis with one rung and a dot on it
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a vertical energy axis, one rung, and a dot sitting on that rung

beats.narration_text: One operator bumps any state up exactly one rung of energy.
beats.tts_normalized_text: One operator bumps any state up exactly one rung of energy.
beats.new_visual_element: raise operator: up arrow steps the dot up one new rung
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a raise arrow steps the dot up one rung; a new rung appears above; label 'raise'

beats.narration_text: Another operator bumps it back down, exactly one rung at a time.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Another operator bumps it back down, exactly one rung at a time.
beats.new_visual_element: lower operator: down arrow steps the dot down one rung
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a lower arrow steps the dot down one rung, adding a rung below; label 'lower'

beats.narration_text: Keep lowering and the dot marches down toward the bottom.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Keep lowering and the dot marches down toward the bottom.
beats.new_visual_element: the dot steps down two more rungs to the floor
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: step the dot down a couple more rungs, adding rungs, until it reaches the bottom rung

beats.narration_text: But energy can't be negative — so the bottom rung is a floor the lowering operator kills.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But energy can't be negative — so the bottom rung is a floor the lowering operator kills.
beats.new_visual_element: lowering at the floor hits a red X (state destroyed)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: mark the floor in red; try to lower below it and show a red X / 'nothing' — the floor cannot be passed

beats.narration_text: From that floor, the raising operator generates every level above it.
beats.tts_normalized_text: From that floor, the raising operator generates every level above it.
beats.new_visual_element: raising repeatedly builds the whole ladder upward
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: from the floor, repeatedly raise — accumulate rungs all the way up as the dot climbs

beats.narration_text: And every rung is the same step apart — a perfectly even ladder.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And every rung is the same step apart — a perfectly even ladder.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: bracket the equal spacing between consecutive rungs to show the ladder is perfectly even

beats.narration_text: The whole infinite spectrum, found by stepping a ladder — no equation ever solved.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The whole infinite spectrum, found by stepping a ladder — no equation ever solved.
beats.new_visual_element: red label 'the whole spectrum, no equation solved'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the ladder and write a red label 'the whole spectrum, no equation solved'; clean close
